attributes.name: ypy-persist
attributes.description: Keeps the element (it needs an `id`) in the page across a navigation whose response has an element with the same id. `false` turns it off.

attributes.name: ypy-track
attributes.description: On an element of the page, usually in `<head>`: its value (`content`, `href`, `src`, `value` or text) is compared with the same element of a page response. A difference means a new deploy: the page is loaded instead of swapped.

values.name: reload
values.description: Load the response as a page when the tracked values change.

events.name: ypy:track:reload
events.description: A page response carries other `ypy-track="reload"` values than the page. Cancel it to swap the response instead of loading `url`.
